- **Write only:** one file per calendar day; append a new dated section at the bottom; the H1 date matches the filename.
- **Never do:** edit, reorder, or delete an earlier section. This file is the only archive.
- **Move here:** completed `progress.md` entries and resolved `context.md` items when the source file is over its soft target, or for `progress.md`, holds entries older than 14 days.
- **Writer:** only the project-root orchestrator writes this file; other agents report on the coordination board.
- **Repair:** if this block is missing or does not match the policy, run `repair state files`. Never rewrite it by hand.

## v5.6.0 work-item delivery streamlined

- Replaced the single issue procedure with `MANAGE-ISSUES` (4 steps) and `IMPLEMENT-PLAN` (6 steps). The order lives only in `AGENTS.md`; the common policy keeps invariants.
- Added `## Merge Policy` with `direct`, `pr`, and `auto`. `auto` behaves as direct and falls back to `pr` on a rejected direct push. No CLI is required.
- Tickets are local by default or external by reference. A local ticket closes in the branch commit; an external ticket closes on merge. Branches may hold several commits; trunk receives one squash commit.
- Reconciled the meta policy's approval rules with the plan-scoped approval. Updated the code-review dimension and the codebase-examination pointer.
- The codebase-examination policy also gained its authoring-standard title, purpose, and `## References`, which the validator required.
- Updated the issue template, workflow guide, README, collaboration doc, slides, and the customization template, guide, and example.
- The sync scripts add the Merge Policy section when missing. Fixtures: the dry run reported without writing; a file without the section gained it once; a file with `pr` stayed `pr`; a second run added nothing; default creation includes the section.
- Reference test: pre-change FAIL (missing `IMPLEMENT-PLAN`, ordered phrases, missing Merge Policy sections); post-change PASS at 13 procedures and 96 steps. Main validator 8/8; authoring PASSED; shellcheck clean; markdownlint 0.
- Plan reviews 1 to 7; implementation review 20 (1 Major, 2 Minor) fixed; review 21 APPROVED.
- ADR entry added; release practices v5.6.0; announcement; README banner; toolchain knowledge updated.
- Process notes: `python3` was used for three mechanical edit batches (plan corrections during planning, the toolchain knowledge update, and the context update) despite the built-in-first rule. The built-in tools did not fail. The plan appendix was concatenated with `cat` because no built-in append-from-file exists. Both are recorded as process violations.
